text:
Predicates:
Cattle(x) ::: x is a Brown Swiss cattle.
Cow(x) ::: x is a cow.
Pet(x) ::: x is a pet.
Domesticated(x) ::: x is a domesticated animal.
Alligator(x) ::: x is an alligator.
Ted ::: Ted.
Premises:
∀x (Cattle(x) → Cow(x)) ::: All Brown Swiss cattle are cows.
∃x (Pet(x) ∧ Cattle(x)) ::: Some pets are Brown Swiss cattle.
∀x (Cow(x) → Domesticated(x)) ::: All cows are domesticated animals.
¬Domesticated(alligator) ::: Alligators are not domesticated animals.
Alligator(Ted) ::: Ted is an alligator.
Conclusion:
Pet(Ted) ∧ Cattle(Ted) ::: Ted is a pet and Brown Swiss cattle.
